top_choice_rationale: GLP-1 physiology and identification of its active form is a mature, original and extensively replicated discovery chain, from proglucagon processing and the incretin effect to receptor biology and drugs with proven benefit in type 2 diabetes, obesity and cardiorenal outcomes. Drucker, Holst and Mojsov each carry a distinct documented part of the discovery core, and the citation is scoped to physiology and the active peptide, which keeps the three-person allocation clean. No award is clearly inferior to a well-supported prize of this quality.
